arxiv-2111-04236.title: Non-adiabatic Quantum Wavepacket Dynamics Simulation Based on Electronic Structure Calculations using the Variational Quantum Eigensolver
arxiv-2111-04236.creator: Hirotoshi Hirai
arxiv-2111-04236.description: Abstract A non-adiabatic nuclear wavepacket dynamics simulation of the H 2 O + de-excitation process is performed based on electronic structure calculations using the variational quantum eigensolver. The adiabatic potential energy surfaces and non-adiabatic coupling vectors are computed with algorithms for noisy intermediate-scale quantum devices, and time propagation is simulated with conventional methods for classical computers.

arxiv-2210-13865.title: Missing Counter-Evidence Renders NLP Fact-Checking Unrealistic for Misinformation
arxiv-2210-13865.creator: Max Glockner, Yufang Hou, Iryna Gurevych
arxiv-2210-13865.description: Abstract Misinformation emerges in times of uncertainty when credible information is limited. This is challenging for NLP-based fact-checking as it relies on counter-evidence, which may not yet be available. Despite increasing interest in automatic fact-checking, it is still unclear if automated approaches can realistically refute harmful real-world misinformation.

arxiv-2301-10258.title: A many-body singlet prepared by a central spin qubit
arxiv-2301-10258.creator: Leon Zaporski 1,*, Stijn R. de Wit 1,2,*, Takuya Isogawa 1, Martin Hayhurst Appel 1, Claire Le Gall 1, Mete Atatüre 1, † \dagger, Dorian A. Gangloff 3, † \dagger
arxiv-2301-10258.description: Abstract Controllable quantum many-body systems are platforms for fundamental investigations into the nature of entanglement and promise to deliver computational speed-up for a broad class of algorithms and simulations. In particular, engineering entanglement within a dense spin ensemble can turn it into a robust quantum memory or a computational platform.

arxiv-2406-01425.title: Sensitivity-Informed Augmentation for Robust Segmentation Conference: ; June 03, 2024; USA
arxiv-2406-01425.creator: Laura Zheng, Wenjie Wei, Tony Wu, Jacob Clements, Shreelekha Revankar, Andre Harrison, Yu Shen, Ming C. Lin
arxiv-2406-01425.description: Abstract . Segmentation is an integral module in many visual computing applications such as virtual try-on, medical imaging, autonomous driving, and agricultural automation. These applications often involve either widespread consumer use or highly variable environments, both of which can degrade the quality of visual sensor data, whether from a common mobile phone or an expensive satellite imaging camera.

arxiv-2409-04186.title: Randomness in quantum random number generator from vacuum fluctuations with source-device-independence
arxiv-2409-04186.creator: Megha Shrivastava, Mohit Mittal, Isha Kumari, Venkat Abhignan
arxiv-2409-04186.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Megha Shrivastava, Mohit Mittal, Isha Kumari, Venkat Abhignan. The application for random numbers is ubiquitous. We experimentally build a well-studied quantum random number generator from homodyne measurements on the quadrature of the vacuum fluctuations. Semi-device-independence in this random number generator is usually obtained using phase modulators to shift the phase of the laser and obtain random sampling from both X and P quadrature measurements of the vacuum state in previous implementations.

pmc-11517246.creator: P Surma, A Micek, M Bednarek-Chałuda, K Stoll, I Nenko
pmc-11517246.description: BackgroundIn Poland, cesarean section (CS) rate is 48% what means that it is one of the highest rate among OECD countries and the highest in the European Union. WHO has considered that CS rates higher than 15% at the population level are not associated with reductions in maternal and newborn mortality rates.

pmc-11642285.title: Gas-Sensing Properties of Co9S8 Films Toward Formaldehyde, Ethanol, and Hydrogen Sulfide
pmc-11642285.creator: Myeong Gyu Kim, Yun-Hyuk Choi, Matteo Tonezzer
pmc-11642285.description: The chemiresistive gas-sensing properties of pristine Co9S8 film are little known despite its potential as a promising gas sensor material due to its intrinsic characteristics. In this study, a pristine polycrystalline Co9S8 film (approximately 440 nm in thickness) is fabricated by depositing a Co3O4 film followed by sulfidation to investigate its gas-sensing properties.

pmc-11679496.title: Optimization and Standardization of the Extraction Method of Balanites aegyptiaca Del. Seeds (Zygophyllaceae) Used in the Formulation of an Antiparasitic Phytomedicine
pmc-11679496.creator: Mohamed Bonewendé Belemlilga, Salfo Ouedraogo, Gilchrist Abdoul Laurent Boly, Do Harouna Dao, Jonas Tiami Coulibaly, Jean Claude Romaric Pingdwindé Ouedraogo, Souleymane Compaoré, Sidiki Traore, Moumouni Koala, Estelle Noëla Hoho Youl, Lazare Belemnaba, Félix Bondo Kini, Aristide Traore, Séni Kouand
pmc-11679496.description: Background/Objectives: Balanites aegyptiaca Del. (Zygophyllaceae) is widely used in traditional medicine, both human and veterinary, throughout Africa for its many properties, including antiparasitic properties. This experimental study aims to optimize the extraction conditions of the seeds of Balanites aegyptiaca Del.

pmc-13085024.title: Screening of a quinonoid compounds library identifies decylubiquinone as an antioxidant and anti-apoptotic agent against glucocorticoid-induced osteoporosis via CD39/CD73/adenosine axis
pmc-13085024.creator: Yu Xu, Wenpeng Xu, Wencan Zhang, Shangzhi Li, Dingxin Zhang, Xiangyu Lin, Qian Sun, Yanguo Wang, Peijie Hu, Haipeng Si
pmc-13085024.description: Glucocorticoid-induced osteoporosis (GIOP) is a prevalent and serious side effect of long-term glucocorticoid therapy, characterized by elevated oxidative stress and profound suppression of bone formation. There is a lack of therapies that effectively target the underlying oxidative stress and impaired osteogenesis simultaneously. In this study, we aimed to identify novel therapeutic agents from a library of quinonoid compounds.

pmc-13198133.title: Acute ST-Segment Elevation Myocardial Infarction Secondary to Neoplastic Infiltration of the Left Anterior Descending Artery
pmc-13198133.creator: Andre M Nicolau, Lucas Oliveira, Filippe Filippini, Jose C Nicolau, Carlos M Campos, Roberto Rocha Giraldez, Vera Aiello, Fabio Sandoli de Brito, Alexandre Abizaid, Henrique B Ribeiro
pmc-13198133.description: BackgroundNeoplastic infiltration of the coronary arteries is an exceptionally rare cause of ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction and may closely mimic atherosclerotic acute coronary occlusion on clinical presentation and angiography.Case SummaryA 69-year-old woman presented with new-onset angina and worsening chest pain. Electrocardiography demonstrated ST-segment elevation in the anterior leads.

pmc-13247976.title: Ultra-deep vs. standard swept-source optical coherence tomography for posterior vitreous detachment assessment: a retrospective comparative study
pmc-13247976.creator: Zhuangling Lin, Kai Gao, Rebiya Tuxun, Guanli Zhu, Yuan Ma, Yuan Liu, Baoyi Liu, Runping Duan, Zhuojun Xu, Yang Meng, Yaping Liu, Ziye Chen, Chin-Ling Tsai, Lan Jiang, Tao Li
pmc-13247976.description: BackgroundThe efficacy of ultra-deep mode of swept-source optical coherence tomography (SS-OCT) for evaluating posterior vitreous detachment (PVD) remains unknown. The study aimed to compare the ultra-deep mode (scan length: 26 mm, scan depth: 12 mm) and standard mode (scan length: 16 mm, scan depth: 3 mm) of SS-OCT in PVD assessment.

pmc-13487233.title: ERG preserves endothelial identity to limit atherosclerosis
pmc-13487233.creator: Steven R Botts, Corey A Scipione, Kristen Schulz, Leandro C D Breda, Kai Ellis, Christy Ho, Sneha Raju, Kamalben Prajapati, Kai Yu, Aniqa B Khan, Chanele K Polenz, Stylianos Z Prattas, Sharon J Hyduk, Christian Cao, Joshua D Wythe, Clint S Robbins, Clint L Miller, Myron I Cybulsky, Jason E Fish, Kat
pmc-13487233.description: Endothelial function is a safeguard against atherosclerosis, yet endothelial‑to‑mesenchymal transition (EndMT) can occur at atheroprone sites. How endothelial identity loss contributes to atherogenesis remains unclear. Here we investigated the role of the ETS transcription factor ERG, a key regulator of endothelial identity, in atheroprogression. Inducible endothelial Erg deletion increased plaque burden in hypercholesterolemic mice.

pmc-13637401.title: Intersection of gender and race/skin color and food consumption of adolescents: analysis of Brazil’s National Student Health Survey (PENSE) 2019
pmc-13637401.creator: Thays Maria Sant’Anna Rosa, Francine Silva dos Santos, Daniela Silva Canella
pmc-13637401.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundFood consumption of adolescents is characterized by a highly prevalent intake of ultra-processed food and a low intake of fresh or minimally processed foods. Factors such as income, gender, race/skin color, and their intersection can influence this consumption. The objective of this study was to analyze the relationship between food consumption and intersections of race/skin color and gender among Brazilian adolescents.MethodsData from Brazil’s National Student Health Survey of 2019 was used.
